ipeds.title: IPEDS College Navigator (fall 2024 admissions and test scores, 2024-25 expenses)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (Fall 2025): 10,360 applied (3,506 men, 6,854 women), 9,795 admitted (94.5%), 2,137 enrolled (1,524 in-state, 600 out-of-state, 13 international). The Common Data Set's international applicant and admit cells are blank. IPEDS reports 12,982 applicants and a 71% admit rate for fall 2024, but the fall 2024 Common Data Set also shows about 9,200 admits (9,906 applied), so the two sources count applicants differently. Undergraduate enrollment 9,530 and nonresident count 111 are the 'Total Undergraduates' figures. SAT/ACT percentile ranges come from IPEDS (fall 2024) because the 2025-26 Common Data Set PDF text is partly garbled (it lists an SAT composite 25th/50th/75th of 1010/1090/1200). GPA bands are the 'all enrolled students' column. The Common Data Set checkbox sections (admission factors, test policy and aid to nonresidents) are not reliably legible, so factors are omitted.
